consent.title: Cookies
consent.description: May we measure how the app is used, with Google Analytics? It sets cookies and sends Google your visit. Nothing is measured unless you accept, and you can change your mind any time in Réglages, “Manage cookies”.

signIn.text: You'll sign in with your organization's account.
